claim: The previous ACPM unresolved-symbol failure was caused by loading acpm-protocol without its exynos-mailbox prerequisite; the corrected stage now enforces mailbox -> ACPM -> touch-supply-hold -> input30 order.
oracle: On a fresh diagnostic boot, all four modules load without an unresolved symbol, the SPI device binds, INPUT30_READY appears, and the guarded GUI handoff remains pending until its own serial/watchdog/partition checks pass.

user_journey.scenario: The operator recovers a Pixel 6 that is stuck at the Linux command line and wants the touch-enabled Omarchy desktop without overwriting Android slot A.
user_journey.expected: The recovery sequence is repeatable from a clean boot, reports a precise module-order failure if a prerequisite is missing, and leaves the device recoverable through Fastboot or serial.

invariants: The stage refuses to continue when modules_disabled is nonzero or the stage marker already exists.
exynos-mailbox is loaded before acpm-protocol; acpm-protocol is loaded before the rail-hold module.
The script only loads modules and validates input; it never writes a partition or creates the GUI continuation marker.
gitnexus: The module stage is a prerequisite of serial-input30-gui-handoff.sh and keeps the handoff's existing guards intact.
ast: The shell script has explicit file, state, binding and dmesg checks; its syntax passes sh -n.

unit.red: The live trial loaded acpm-protocol without exynos-mailbox and produced unknown symbol devm_acpm_get_by_node.
unit.green: The corrected loader encodes the known-good mailbox -> ACPM order and passes sh -n.

boundaries: Fastboot recovery -> diagnostic initramfs -> module dependency order -> SPI touch input -> guarded GUI handoff
evidence: Prior private logs show successful runs load exynos-mailbox.ko before acpm-protocol.ko.
The new loader is checked into experiments/serial-input30-module-stage.sh and has passed sh -n.
A fresh hardware rerun is still required before claiming desktop readiness.

limitations: The corrected loader has not yet been rerun on a fresh phone boot in this checkpoint.
GPU acceleration, Wi-Fi, China Mobile data, camera capture, sensors and persistent graphical startup remain unverified.
No partition, radio, calibration or Android recovery data was written.
publication: No vendor firmware, calibration, credentials, private logs, MAC addresses, SSIDs, IMEIs or serial numbers are included.
next_gate: After the user confirms Fastboot recovery, run the corrected module stage on a fresh boot, then execute the existing guarded GUI handoff and capture fresh GPU/input evidence.
